bound_rationale: Use the existing validated control-plane convention of 1000 bounded iterations. Sample every 10 cycles and exclude only the first 100 cycles from steady-state leak evaluation.
execution_contract: Each cycle is the already-accepted deterministic E2 recovery canary.
Each cycle must fence generation 0, advance process and session generation 0->1, reject the late stale result without durable mutation, and complete on the replacement generation.

The soak may observe only the current process tree and in-memory durable test graph; it must not call a model, browser, GPU/NVIDIA interface, PADataset, Workspace Shell privileged helper, or candidate-history mutation surface.
Resource sampling is read-only and may not alter semantic workflow state.

precommitted_acceptance_rules.cycle_correctness: All 1000 cycles PASS the accepted E2 recovery assertions; any exception or semantic mismatch fails C2.
precommitted_acceptance_rules.discrete_resource_rule: After warmup, process count, thread count, file-descriptor count, and managed child-process count must each remain invariant across available samples; the post-soak cleanup sample may not exceed that steady-state maximum.
precommitted_acceptance_rules.rss_pss_growth_rule: After warmup, split available RSS and PSS samples into three chronological windows. Fail a metric only when both the window medians and window minima strictly increase across all three windows. RSS is required; PSS may be explicitly UNAVAILABLE.
precommitted_acceptance_rules.required_metrics: CPU user/system deltas, RSS, peak RSS, thread count, file-descriptor count and managed-child count must be available for steady-state evaluation. Missing data fails required metrics; optional PSS remains explicit.
precommitted_acceptance_rules.sampling_gaps: Gap and estimated-missing-sample counts must be reported. Gaps are evidence, not silently discarded.
precommitted_acceptance_rules.cleanup: No unresolved manual-ready, sent-unconfirmed, awaiting-ack, nonterminal process, unreaped managed child, or resource-count increase may remain at cleanup.
